messages:
morgan: Quick async check — where are we on token-cost attribution + latency tagging for the next canary? Need owners and a short rollback plan before EOD.
jamie: I can take the event schema changes (embedding/token fields). will coordinate a staged rollout with eng-sre.
sana: Icould own the latency instrumentation (client SDK + server exit tags). what SDKs are in scope for this wave?
alex: node and python are required for GA. go is WIP and opt-in for now. eng-sre says node change is minimal.
priyanka: @jamie please paste the PR link so I can skim. want to avoid breaking existing analytics.
jamie: PR: https://github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/499 — main rename is `token.accounting` -> `billing.token_count_v3` and adding `latency.p99_ms` and `latency.p50_ms`.
morgan: Good. Migration plan? We need to keep dashboards stable for at least 2 weeks.
jamie: Plan is dual-emit for producers behind a feature flag for 14 days; ingest will accept both fields during transition. Added notes in PR description.
zach: infra-bot: canary window proposed 2026-03-18T18:00Z. awaiting approvals.
priyanka: Quick comment: downstream aggregations will need a mapping shim. I'll make a ticket for reports owners.
priyanka: ticket filed: https://tickets.redwood.ai/AN-6110 — includes request for example mapping and owners.
sana: SDK releases: I'll open minor bump PRs for node/python after schema is merged. estimate 1.5 hrs total.
alex: saw an event-lint CI failure locally due to proto mismatch — can someone sync with eng-ml to pin the formatter?
jamie: on it, pinged eng-ml in the PR and added a repro snippet.
morgan: Action summary: jamie = merge schema + trigger infra canary; sana = SDK PRs; priyanka = mapping ticket & ping reports; alex = notify dashboard owners. reconvene in this thread after canary.
zach: infra-bot: canary started — step 1 deploy ok, step 2 smoke tests running.
priyanka: Add an example query mapping legacy -> new fields in ticket to help teams convert alerts.
jamie: Added example SQL and an Elasticsearch mapping example to the ticket and PR.
alex: If smoke fails, fallback approach = disable new-field emit from producers (turn off feature flag). comfortable with that?
morgan: Yes, fallback is to stop emitting new fields and let ingest continue to serve old format. good contingency.
priyanka: LGTM from analytics side pending canary green. will follow up on ticket assignment.
jamie: Canary smoke tests all green (6/6). merging now.
sana: Opening SDK PRs and will link back here once published.
alex: Posting a note to dashboards-owners with the mapping ticket and ETA.
morgan: Thanks all — I'll monitor alerts and reopen thread if anything anomalous shows up. :rocket:
